errors.text_span: The counts remain low and relatively flat from -1.0 to approximately -0.4
errors.evidence: The counts are only flat until a polarity score of approximately -0.7. After that point, the counts begin to rise, reaching approximately 4,000 by a score of -0.5.
At a polarity score of -0.2, the count is approximately 5,000, not 10,000. The count reaches approximately 11,000 at a score closer to -0.1.
The chart shows a secondary peak at a polarity score of 0.2, with a count of approximately 28,000. The description incorrectly states there is a decline to this point and reports the value as 17,000.
At a polarity score of 0.4, the count is very low, close to zero (around 500). The count at a score of 0.3 is closer to 9,000.
At a polarity score of 0.6, the count is close to zero. The chart shows a rise to approximately 10,000 at a score of 0.5.
